description: An FPGA chip evolved over 5000 generations to tell two tones apart used components not wired to inputs or outputs and worked best at night, which its builders traced to field coupling with a radio (Thompson et al. 1996, as reported by McFadden).
limitations: Reported secondhand in McFadden 2020. Not explored further, by his account. Shows field computing in a device, not consciousness.

sources.quote: harnessed EMF coupling between the FPGA chip and the radio
